meta.title: Who builds, holds land and provides housing services, by Colorado county and town
meta.method: Developers are sponsors and grantees on state housing awards and CHFA tax-credit applications since 2016. Land holders come from the Colorado Public Parcels composite, grouped by owner as printed on the county record; acres are mapped parcel area. Providers are HUD public housing authorities, HUD-approved housing counseling agencies and IRS-listed housing and shelter charities (NTEE L, without homeowner associations, plus P85 homeless service centres).
meta.public_safety: This public file gives counts and shares by type and names only public bodies and nonprofits. Company names, private land owners and people are in the gated detail files only; people are never named anywhere.
